findingDispositions.assessment: The exact closed cache snapshots state, owner(worker/fence/exact original lease) and all six counters plus complete bounded header/dbTime/number/hash fields. Twelve named parent fields plus these three mutable fields exactly cover the existing fifteen-field Session. Existing V30 guards protect the parent fields except schemaVersion/authConnection; the selected one-way V34 ownership_facts_sealed guard makes those two immutable before the first new-protocol cached reply, without retroactively creating grants or editing old document bytes. Actual service source initializes authConnection at start and has no later writer removed by this seal. ParentFactsHash and full original replyHash verify reconstructed exact field values/array order/time text, with no current state/counter/lease/dbTime substitution. Retained exact duplicate is checked against current authenticated worker/assignment/fence/mode/source/eligible parent and its own original expiry; older replaced counters refuse. Backend restart only rebuilds a still-live retained acknowledgment, while recovered worker journal cannot relaunch. Lease/cache/seal/counter writes are atomic and bounded. A separate ownership-only1MiB+4096 response cap preserves the whole supported Session instead of fitting it into6144 progress.

The selected FAILED/TIMEOUT and FAILED/POLICY_DENIED tuples with dispatchCount1/assertionPassednull are accepted by the actual existing verifier; detailed timeout/withdrawal/cancellation cause remains in the authenticated wrapper and selected EXPIRED/CANCELLED session state. The new gated handler explicitly reuses validation/locked primitives instead of blindly calling outcomeV2, which would select session FAILED. Saving conclusive FAILED before stop makes the existing stop loop leave it unchanged. If stop/UNKNOWN/epoch/fence/source or a terminal action already won, one bounded historical receipt cannot rewrite the terminal tuple, add availability/bootstrap/current observation, or enable publication. SETUP has no action row and can claim NOT_INVOKED only before provider or browser invocation starts; begun/uncertain work remains UNKNOWN/quarantined.
